mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level directly reduces the risk-free rate used in equity discounting models, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of observations where FEDFUNDS is below the 50th percentile of its historical range, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins through wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals a failure of monetary policy to control inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST above 1500.0), rising housing starts signal strong consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payroll employment directly reflects a strong labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of observations where PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical range, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, defined by high non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 137000.0) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), signals robust consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 137000.0 and UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the market reacts negatively to persistent inflation as it signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.
